recipes.title: Caramel Protein French Toast Cloud (Greek Yogurt)

items.i: powdered sugar or sweetener, to dust (optional)

steps: Whisk the yogurt and eggs, then whisk in the cornflour until smooth.
Pour into a small baking dish lined with baking paper.
Bake at 200°C (about 390°F) for around 45 minutes until puffed and deep golden; ovens vary, so keep an eye on it. (The original video bakes it at 350°F for 1 hour.)
Drizzle with the sugar-free caramel and dust with powdered sugar.
recipes.notes: Recipe and macros are the creator's: 661 cal and 66 g protein for the whole thing, or 83 cal and 8.3 g protein per slice of 8.
